scenes.subjectHint: Ảnh hook split-frame: ngôi sao Đức (trái) đối đầu ngôi sao Bờ Biển Ngà (phải)
scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16 football poster artwork featuring a dramatic split-frame face-off. Left half: Florian Wirtz, German midfielder of the Germany national team, in the white Germany home kit, captured chest-up in a determined power pose with arms tensed, lit by cool electric-blue light rays. Right half: Amad Diallo, Ivory Coast winger of the Cote d'Ivoire national team, in the vivid orange Ivory Coast home kit, captured chest-up in an explosive sprinting pose, lit by warm orange light rays. A jagged lightning bolt seam splits the two halves down the center, a small golden World Cup trophy accent glows at the top center, stadium-floodlight haze and confetti sparks in the deep background. The Germany crest visible on the left jersey and the Ivory Coast crest visible on the right jersey, no on-image text or captions, no scoreboard graphics.
